Submission Guidelines
Extended Abstract Submission

ICBR 2026 accepts extended abstract submissions only. Authors are not required to submit a full paper or a separate manuscript.

All contributed papers should be submitted via the Microsoft CMT system.
Please be assured that https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/ICBHR2026 is the official submission site for ICBR 2026.

Submission Requirements

All submissions must meet the following requirements:

Language: English;
Abstract length: No more than 500 words;
Title length: No more than 15 words;
Keywords: Two to five keywords;
Graphical Abstract: a graphical abstract is required to illustrate your work;
Submission method: Online submission through Microsoft CMT;
Full paper: Not required;
References: Not permitted in the abstract text.

The title, author names, and affiliations must be entered separately in CMT and are not included in the 300-word limit.

Abstract Content

The abstract should provide a concise and self-contained summary of the work and is recommended to include the following elements:

Objective: The research problem, background, and principal objective;
Methods: The experimental, computational, theoretical, biological, or engineering approach;
Results: The principal findings, including quantitative data or substantive preliminary results where applicable;
Conclusion: The main conclusion and significance of the work.

Section headings such as Objective, Methods, Results, and Conclusion may be used but are not mandatory.

Title and Keywords

The title should be concise, informative, and accurately reflect the main contribution of the work. Unnecessary abbreviations and promotional wording should be avoided.

Authors must provide two to five keywords that accurately describe the subject of the submission.

Author Information in CMT

Each author must be entered separately in CMT. The following information should be provided:

Given name and family name;
Institutional affiliation;
Country or region;
Email address; and
Author order.

One author must be identified as the Presenting Author, and one author must be identified as the Corresponding Author. The same person may serve in both roles.

The author information entered in CMT must be consistent with the submitted abstract.

Tables, Figures, and Special Characters

With the exception of the graphical abstract, other tables, figures and images are not permitted in the extended abstract content.

Special characters, mathematical symbols, Greek letters, subscripts, and superscripts should be entered using the formatting functions provided by CMT.

Submission Help

At least one author of your work should have a CMT account before submitting your work to the CMT system.
